headline: Athens Stock Exchange: Sellers step up - Banks plunge up to 4%
summary: Athens Stock Exchange sellers stepped up as banks fell up to 4%, with the return of Brent oil prices and bond yields at high levels cited as factors in the renewed deterioration.
why: The Athens bourse is Greece's main equity market, and its large banks are sensitive to bond yields and oil-driven inflation expectations.
why_moved: Brent oil prices returned and bond yields stayed at high levels, according to the report, pressuring banks, which fell up to 4%.
